{"code": "    def sanitize_email(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Replace all email addresses with ``[REDACTED_EMAIL]``.

        BUG_65: the regex ``[\\w.]+@[\\w.]+`` does not include ``+``
        in the local-part character class, so plus-addressed emails
        like ``user+tag@domain.com`` are **not** redacted.
        Should be ``[\\w.+]+@[\\w.]+``.
        """
        # BUG_65: Fixed regex to include + in local-part character class
        email_pattern = re.compile(r"[\w.+]+@[\w.]+")
        result = email_pattern.sub(_REDACTED_EMAIL, text)
        count = len(email_pattern.findall(text))
        self._history.append(
            SanitizationResult(text=result, emails_redacted=count)
        )
        return result", "comments": "Fixed email regex pattern to include + character in local-part character class so plus-addressed emails like user+tag@domain.com are properly redacted."}
```
